items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: Illinois Jacquet's big band, at that time which was a very good band, including people like Budd Johnson... I mentioned the fact that Budd Johnson was with the band.

ctx.x: for Basie, but it wasn't Basie's type of tune. And we had three ballads that we gave us that had been... I don't know who they'd been written for. The other arrangements were one arrangement by Budd Johnson called "Stay In The Mood For Love." There was another one... Dizzy had his "Night In Tunisia" and "Round Midnight." Oh, he had another blues, too. There was a blues that Dizzy wrote. It was a vocal that Billie sang. And then there was a Lucky Thompson arrangement. So there must have been nine arrangements that…

So the band rehearsed on Wednesday, it rehearsed on Thursday. Our first job was Friday night in Wilmington, Delaware. I'm wondering how in the world that this band, this big band of 17 pieces, is going to play a dance with eight arrangements! Well, I had worked with bands of 13-14 pieces around Washington locally, and everything we played practically was music.
